content:
As we hit July's Black Friday sales season, this week brings a notable round of Apple discounts, including one of the best AirPods deals in recent months:

Beyond the deals above, Amazon also has a range of low-priced products, including the 2026 AirTag 2 starting from US$22, the official iPhone Air MagSafe battery at up to 40% off, the Apple Magic Keyboard hitting an all-time low, the Apple Watch Series 11 still discounted from US$299, and M5/Pro MacBook Pro configurations with savings of up to US$400.
